title: HandoffEnvelope
description: The typed thing that flows between Agent Packs. A downstream pack receives THIS and the evidence it references - never the upstream pack's workspace, conversation or internal state. Deliberately provider-neutral: no field here names a cloud, an IaC tool or a scanner, because the whole point of the kernel is that adding one is a pack, not a schema change.

producer.description: Which pack version produced this. Pinned to a content hash: a downstream pack that trusts a producer trusts an exact version of it, never a name.

organization_id.description: Tenant. Checked on receipt, not assumed from context - a handoff carrying another tenant's id is refused, which is the same boundary delivery targets and policy acceptances enforce.

lineage.description: Ordered envelope_ids this one descends from. Makes a composition auditable without replaying it.

status.description: Generic capsule outcome. Never a validation verdict - a pack does not get to say whether evidence passed.

assumptions.description: What the pack had to assume because nobody supplied it. Surfaced, never silently applied.

unknowns.description: What the pack could not determine. An empty list on a design pack is itself suspicious and its own inspector can reject it.

evidence_refs.description: Identifiers of CapsuleEvidenceBundles covering this envelope's artifacts. References, not verdicts: the bundle holds the statuses and the kernel reads them.

payload.description: Pack-declared typed body, validated against the pack's declared produced contract. The kernel does not interpret it.
